statement: The pinned WiiBrew Wiimote EEPROM Memory section documents host-addressed EEPROM reads as using only the low sixteen address bits: the high address byte is ignored, producing a 0x10000-byte mirroring period. Low sixteen-bit offsets 0x0000 through 0x16FF are the documented host-visible range; attempts to read offsets 0x1700 and higher return errors. This is a described host-visible address map, not proof of the physical chip's full writable region or protection behavior.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documentation, no model-specific retail hardware capture
applicability.scope: WiiBrew pinned oldids: Wiimote oldid 123257, EEPROM Memory. Related: wii-gap-wiibrew-host-eeprom-visible-range, wii-memory-size-hypothesis (MUST remain unknown for retail-reference measurements), wii-gap-rnconrad-eeprom-exclusive-upper-bound and wii-gap-dolphin-eeprom-inclusive-bound. Does not claim that high-address writes mirror identically. Community-source evidence only, not device measurement.
